_note: Source registry (2026-10-20). Every advice number in the tool points here through src/data/provenance.ts; the audit (test/sources.test.ts) fails on an unknown id. kind: primary = measured or specified by the originator (paper, FishBase measured row, manufacturer spec); reference = a curated database or care reference (FishBase Bayesian estimate, Tropica); consensus = hobby practice where several sources agree; tool = another calculator we match on purpose (fitted, not a biological claim); retailer = a product or price page (the row carries its own url); internal = our own committed research note or calibration, which itself lists the outside pages it read. accessed = the date the code first cited it. Never add an entry for a page nobody opened.
